verdict.line: You lose if you eat Camille's delayed empowered Q auto while trading blind and let her set up E (Hookshot) off a nearby wall; you win if you dash into her only after E (Flawless Duet) lands its stun and press with Q (Bladesurge) resets before her R comes online.

brief.thesis: Camille's entire threat is conditional on terrain and cooldown windows: E (Hookshot) needs a wall to leap from, and her Q (Precision Protocol) recast only hits hard if she delays the second cast. Irelia's E (Flawless Duet) stun plus Q's Mark-refresh removes the guesswork from her own engage, which is why the data shows an Irelia solo-kill edge despite the head-to-head win rate sitting close to even at 49.1% over 823 games.

theirWindow.when: Camille has Q up and delays the recast
theirWindow.what: That delayed second cast of Precision Protocol does significantly more bonus damage than the immediate recast, and every auto she lands also builds her Adaptive Defenses shield. Don't stand and trade through it; disengage after her first hit and let W (Defiant Dance) soak the follow-up instead.

yourWindow.when: Passive at 4 stacks and E off cooldown
yourWindow.what: Open with E (Flawless Duet) for the stun and Mark, then Q (Bladesurge) into her — the Mark refreshes Bladesurge's cooldown so you can chain a second dash mid-fight while your max passive stacks add bonus on-hit damage to every hit.

start.why: Run by 90.6% of Irelia players in this matchup (48.6% WR, 880 games) — the extra HP and sustain cover the AA trades Camille's Q and cone W force you into.

boots.why: 85% pick rate (49.1% WR, 764 games); Camille's kit leans on repeated basic attacks to stack her Adaptive Defenses shield, and flat AA damage reduction blunts every one of those hits.

core.why: Current-health damage keeps punishing Camille as she builds tankier, and the active slow stops her from just walking away after a shielded trade.
No minion dependency needed — it's a straight DPS spike for the skirmishes this matchup is actually decided in.
Physical damage reduction plus healing lets you survive extended Q/W exchanges and stay in a fight even after she lands R.

situational.when: camille's R (Hextech Ultimatum) bonus magic damage on her autos starts adding up in extended fights
you're ahead and want to end skirmishes faster instead of grinding through her shield with sustained DPS
her team has follow-up pick potential to punish you after she lands E into R

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks up during the exact prolonged auto/spell exchanges this lane produces, and the healing offsets Camille's Q poke and W cone damage while you close the gap.

summoners.why: The most-run pairing at 84.5% pick (47.4% WR) — Ignite pressures Camille before she has R sustain, and it's the spell that actually converts the data's stated solo-kill advantage into a kill.

playing.title: Trade after E lands, not before
playing.detail: Only commit to an all-in once Flawless Duet's stun is confirmed. Walking in without it just lets Camille land her empowered Q auto for free.

playing.title: Charge W into her empowered Q
playing.detail: Defiant Dance's damage reduction window is your answer to the delayed recast of Precision Protocol — start the charge as she goes for the second hit.

playing.title: Engage only at 4 passive stacks
playing.detail: Ionian Fervor's bonus on-hit damage only kicks in at max stacks; extended trades swing hard in your favor once you're capped.

playing.title: Respect wall-adjacent positioning
playing.detail: Hookshot requires a wall to leap from and knocks up on landing. Once Camille hits level 2, give tri-brush and jungle walls extra space so she can't set the combo up for free.

playing.title: Track her E and R cooldowns after level 6
playing.detail: A landed E followed by R anchors you in place for an extended duel. If she's near a wall with E up post-6, disengage rather than keep farming.

playing.title: Chain Q through Marked targets
playing.detail: Bladesurge refreshes on kill or on a Marked target, so follow E's Mark with Q to reposition mid-fight and reapply on-hit procs without burning a second cooldown cycle.

playing.title: Force fights once your core lands
playing.detail: With Blade of The Ruined King, Hullbreaker, and Death's Dance online, your sustained DPS and healing outscale her burst. Look to skirmish once you're 2-3 items deep rather than dueling even earlier.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, rune page, summoner spell split, and every win rate or pick rate figure above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the cooldown timings, ability behavior, and tactical reasoning tying them together are my own read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being hit with Camille’s (E). Absorb Camille’s (Q) with a well-timed [W], while engaging when Irelia has 4 stacks [P] ready.
